_comment: First-time cards for Btown's own recurring events. first-time.html?event=<key> renders one; table-card.html and hosting-sheet.html read the coffee entry. Facts checked against the Meetup listings Sept 6, 2026. Anything in [CONFIRM] is unverified: fix the fact here and the pages follow. The same facts live in newsletter/reference/drafts/community-kit-2026-09/first-time-cards.md; keep them in step.

coffee.name: BTown Coffee Club
coffee.where: Zero Gravity Beer Hall, 716 Pine Street
coffee.where_detail: Walk in, look right. We're the big table.
coffee.one_line: No agenda, no cost beyond your coffee, and coming alone is normal.
coffee.cost: Free. Buy your own coffee; Zero Gravity's coffee, beer and waffle menu runs 8 AM to 2 PM.
coffee.pace: None. No agenda, no icebreakers, no going round the table. People talk to whoever is next to them. Some weeks 15 people, some weeks 30.
coffee.alone: Most people came alone the first time. Say "is this the Btown table?" and somebody pulls a chair over.
coffee.car_free: GMT Route 5 Pine Street runs Saturdays from the Downtown Transit Center on Cherry Street. On foot it's about 25 minutes from Church Street, straight down Pine. The lakefront bike path is two blocks west.
coffee.car_free_confirm: Nearest Route 5 stop and Saturday frequency not yet confirmed.
coffee.duration: Two hours on the listing. People arrive and leave the whole time. Twenty minutes counts.
coffee.leave_early: Yes. Nobody notices you leaving, in the good way.
coffee.look_for: Steve, the host, or the table card that says "Btown Brief, come sit". If Steve isn't there a regular is, and the card is.
coffee.bring: Nothing. Dogs are welcome on the patio only.
coffee.rsvp: Not needed. Regulars mostly don't. RSVP on Meetup if you want the reminder.
coffee.runs_until: Listed on Meetup through Nov 28, 2026, then re-listed.

basketball.name: Pick-up Basketball
basketball.where: Pomeroy Park, 31 Booth Street, Old North End
basketball.where_detail: The outdoor courts off North Street.
basketball.one_line: Full-court pick-up, free, outdoors. Show up and call next.
basketball.pace: Full-court pick-up and it gets competitive. You don't need to be good, you need to know the game and be able to run. Still learning? Watch a game, jump in when a team is short.
basketball.pace_confirm: Stephen to confirm wording: the Meetup says competitive pick-up, the Sept 4 edition said all skill levels.
basketball.alone: Nearly everyone came alone. Pick-up is built for it: you show up, you say "who's got next", you're on a team.
basketball.car_free: About a 15-minute walk from Church Street, up Elmwood Avenue or North Winooski to North Street. Bike parking on the fence.
basketball.car_free_confirm: Nearest GMT stop not confirmed; Route 7 North Avenue stops are several blocks west.
basketball.duration: Two hours, in games. Games usually start when ten people are there; 10 to 35 show up.
basketball.leave_early: Yes. Leave between games whenever. Arriving late is fine too, just call next.
basketball.look_for: Steve, the host. He's the one who posted this.
basketball.bring: Water. A ball if you have one. A light shirt and a dark shirt so teams are easy.
basketball.weather: Rain cancels; check the Meetup page or Telegram by 4 PM.
basketball.weather_confirm: Rain-call time and winter location not confirmed. Listed through March 10, 2027.
basketball.rsvp: Not needed, but it helps Steve know to wait for you.
